name: aws
notes: Official Arch aws-cli-v2 package provides AWS CLI v2; no profiles or credentials are configured. The separate aws-cli package is v1 and is not a substitute.

name: granted
notes: AWS access utility; the assume shell integration is provided by Granted.

name: aws cdk cli
notes: Official AWS CDK Toolkit CLI; installs the cdk executable.

name: aws sam cli
notes: Official AWS SAM CLI; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles.

name: cfn-lint
notes: Official Arch python-cfn-lint package provides the CloudFormation cfn-lint executable.

name: iamlive
notes: IAM policy generator; its official tap explicitly provides amd64 and arm64 Linux artifacts.

name: session-manager-plugin
notes: Official AWS Debian payload, extracted user-locally without maintainer scripts or host writes. The package declares only libc6; the command points directly to its relocatable Go executable, while systemd/upstart files in the payload are inert.

name: checkov
notes: Infrastructure-as-code security scanner from Homebrew core.

name: gitleaks
notes: Official Arch package for gitleaks.

name: age
notes: Official Arch package for age.

name: just
notes: Official Arch package for just.

name: actionlint
notes: Official Arch package for actionlint.

name: ruff
notes: Python linter and formatter from the official Arch repository.

name: shellcheck
notes: Official Arch package for shellcheck.

name: shfmt
notes: Official Arch package for shfmt.

name: typos
notes: Official Arch package for typos.

name: mise
notes: Polyglot tool-version manager from the official Arch repository; no project tools are installed implicitly.

name: uv
notes: Python package and project manager from the official Arch repository; no Python tools are installed implicitly.

name: yaml-py
notes: Matches the Mac setup's dedicated yaml-py helper: an isolated uv-managed Python interpreter with PyYAML importable, not the unrelated python-yq CLI.

name: tsc
notes: Official TypeScript package; installs the tsc compiler.

name: tsx
notes: TypeScript execution runtime from npm.

name: chezmoi
notes: Official Arch package for chezmoi.

name: cheznav
notes: Chezmoi TUI published on PyPI; requires Python 3.14 or newer.

name: libreoffice
notes: Official Arch libreoffice-fresh suite provides soffice; no documents or accounts are configured.

name: draw.io
notes: Official Arch drawio-desktop package provides the Electron desktop editor.

name: imagemagick
notes: Official Arch package for imagemagick.

name: oxiping
notes: The requested oxiping spelling resolves to the official oxipng PNG optimizer.

name: jpegoptim
notes: Official Arch package for jpegoptim.

name: VLC
notes: Official Arch VLC media player, including its GUI package dependencies.

name: caligula
notes: Official Arch package provides the disk-imaging TUI; setup installs the package but never runs disk-imaging operations.

name: chamber
notes: AWS SSM Parameter Store secrets CLI from Homebrew core.

name: kitty
notes: Official Arch package includes kitty and kitten and their required host libraries.

name: bitwarden
notes: Official Arch desktop client; no vault, account, login, or browser extension is configured.

name: Bruno
notes: Official pinned Debian desktop payloads for x86_64 and aarch64, extracted user-locally without maintainer scripts or host writes; unlike the publisher-documented Flatpak, which currently supports only x86_64, the native payload uses host libraries and can access local collections and host tooling.

name: gitlogue
notes: Animated Git history replay; requires Git and a repository with commit history.

name: VisiData
notes: Terminal tabular-data explorer, exposed as vd and visidata. Formats such as XLSX and Parquet may require optional dependencies not provisioned by setup.

name: dnsglobe
notes: DNS propagation TUI; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64 without an extra tap. Requires outbound access to public DNS resolvers; no firewall or capability changes are applied.

name: oxker
notes: Docker container TUI; Homebrew core provides Linux bottles for x86_64 and arm64. Requires access to an existing Docker daemon, which can be root-equivalent; setup does not change groups, sockets, services, or contexts.

name: llmfit
notes: Hardware-aware LLM recommendations; GPU detection depends on host drivers and probes. Setup does not download models or start services.

name: croc
notes: Encrypted file transfer; network transfers can use public relays. Protect transfer codes. No relay or automatic transfers are configured.

name: grex
notes: Generates regular expressions from examples; review generated expressions for unintended matches and target-engine compatibility.

name: kondo
notes: Project dependency and artifact cleanup can be destructive; setup never runs it or installs kondo-ui.

name: Worktrunk
notes: Git worktree manager exposed as wt; requires Git and conflicts with wiredtiger's wt executable. Shell integration, project hooks, agent plugins, and LLM providers are not configured.

name: Jetbrains mono nerd font
notes: Official Arch package provides the patched JetBrains Mono Nerd Font; pacman verifies the signed package instead of downloading a user-local release archive.
